title: Lior and the Protocol
author: Kestrel Underhill
blurb: Ulyana Oyelaran, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
